title: One-fourth of forms seeking Karnataka voter deletions not available on portal for public scrutiny
description: An October 9 statement from the Karnataka Chief Electoral Officer’s office says 1,10,654 Form 7 applications were received between June 16 and October 8; however, the official portal only showed 81,822 such applications; the CEO and the ECI have previously said details of all Form 7 applications would be made available for public scrutiny
